description.zh:
管控策略描述。

长度为1~1024个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The description of the access control policy.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length. The description can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-) and must start with a letter.

description.zh:
管控策略的生效范围。

取值：RAM，表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效。
description.en:
The effective scope of the access control policy.

The value RAM indicates that the access control policy takes effect only for RAM users and RAM roles.

description.zh:
管控策略内容。

最大长度为4096个字符。

管控策略语言，请参见[管控策略语言](~~179096~~)。

管控策略示例，请参见[自定义管控策略示例](~~181474~~)。
description.en:
The document of the access control policy.

The document can be a maximum of 4,096 characters in length.

For more information about the languages of access control policies, see [Languages of access control policies](~~179096~~).

For more information about the examples of access control policies, see [Examples of custom access control policies](~~181474~~).

description.zh:
管控策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the access control policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. The name can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-) and must start with a letter.

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，创建一个名为`ExampleControlPolicy`的管控策略，禁止修改ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole角色及其权限。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to create a custom access control policy named `ExampleControlPolicy`. This access control policy is used to prohibit modifications to the ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole role and the permissions of the role.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager create-control-policy --policy-name ExampleControlPolicy --description ExampleControlPolicy --effect-scope RAM --policy-document Version_:_1_,_Statement_:_Effect_:_Deny_,_Action_:_ram:UpdateRole_,_ram:DeleteRole_,_ram:AttachPolicyToRole_,_ram:DetachPolicyFromRole_,_Resource_:_acs:ram:0:0:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager CreateControlPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Description ExampleControlPolicy --PolicyName ExampleControlPolicy --PolicyDocument 'Version_:_1_,_Statement_:_Effect_:_Deny_,_Action_:_ram:UpdateRole_,_ram:DeleteRole_,_ram:AttachPolicyToRole_,_ram:DetachPolicyFromRole_,_Resource_:_acs:ram:0:0:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole' --EffectScope RAM
